paragraphs.source_zh: 三成目眦欲裂，使劲瞪着利家。他原本打算先激怒利家，再一起谴责家康的不是，借机让利家出面调解他与加藤之间愈来愈紧张的关系，却万万没想到，利家竟然如此直率、如此严厉地批驳自己。

paragraphs.source_en: Toshiie belonged to no faction; he always remained neutral. Mitsunari knew this very well. Thus, if he were to make Ieyasu his enemy, there was only one man capable of consolidating and uniting the Toyotomi house: Maeda Toshiie, who sat before him now. Yet Toshiie’s words today had all but cast Mitsunari into an abyss of despair.
